entries.title: Imagine Earth
entries.definitive_edition: Imagine Earth Green Planet Bundle on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Green Planet Bundle with Galaxies DLC
primary.why: Imagine Earth is a real-time planet colonization and climate-aware city-building/strategy game from Serious Bros. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS, Workshop and level-editor features, and the Galaxies DLC in the Green Planet Bundle. No console or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC with Galaxies installed is the preferred archive route for complete current content and capture/settings control.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC Steam release with the Galaxies DLC installed. Use macOS or Linux only as native convenience alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Galaxies is DLC, not a separate game or remaster; include it for the most complete current route.
